facts.content: Daniel's sister Hannah lives in Toronto.

facts.evidence: She said it's stress and exhaustion. If I asked about talking to someone, they said I hadn't got time.

facts.evidence: I stopped about two months ago. My legs feel like lead, and I just never went back.

facts.heading: Daniel feels he lost part of himself

facts.evidence: I think I've lost a part of myself. It was the one time in the week nobody could reach me.

facts.evidence: He sends emails at 11 at night and expects an I answer before breakfast. I answer it. Every time. Even if I'm in bed.

facts.heading: Daniel feels horrible about being relieved
facts.content: Daniel feels horrible about being relieved if he loses his job.

facts.evidence: Hurry was going and my hand was shaking. We thought for a second it was a heart attack, but it passed.

facts.evidence: That sounds frightening.
